event.title: SFSCON'26 - 'Open and free software meets C2C design (Workshop)' in Bolzano, Italy

body.p: Tim Janßen, co-founder of Cradle to Cradle NGO, will host this workshop, where participants will identify current digital barriers to circularity and develop practical recommendations develop practical recommendations for long-term software maintenance, hardware repairability, and open documentation under upcoming regulatory frameworks like the Right to Repair and the Digital Product Passport. The outcomes will be documented and published openly through the C2CEI to foster future cross-industry collaborations.
The workshop will be in English and it will take place in the Crane Hall – Workshop A.
